name: Shipment to Stormwind
summary: Shipment to Stormwind is an Alliance delivery quest that concludes William Pestle's candle venture in Elwynn Forest. After gathering large wax candles from the local kobold vermin, adventurers carry the packaged shipment up the road into the Trade District of Stormwind to William's brother, Morgan Pestle.

sections.title: A Family Trade
sections.body: The Pestle brothers maintain an alchemical trade between the pastoral hamlets of Elwynn Forest and the bustling avenues of Stormwind City. William gathers herbs, reagents, and raw goods out in Goldshire, while his brother Morgan runs Pestle's Apothecary in the capital's Trade District. Because William cannot easily leave his post at the Lion's Pride Inn, he relies on travelers heading into the city gates to handle courier duties.

sections.title: From Kobold Wax to Capital Potions
sections.body: The contents of William's parcel consist of large, pungent candles harvested directly from the kobolds infesting the Goldtooth and Jasperlode mines. Kobold tallow is notoriously greasy and foul, but alchemists prize raw tallow and wax for compounding salves, sealing drafty glassware, and brewing base draughts. Delivering the wax to Morgan ensures the apothecary remains well-stocked with cheap, potent ingredients.

faq.answer: The shipment consists of packaged wax candles taken from the kobolds in Elwynn Forest's mines. William's apothecary uses the wax and tallow as reagents for alchemy and brewing.

faq.q: Where do I find Morgan Pestle?
faq.answer: Morgan Pestle works inside Pestle's Apothecary, located in the Trade District of Stormwind City, just a short walk past the main gates.

faq.q: How are William and Morgan Pestle related?
faq.answer: William and Morgan Pestle are brothers who run an alchemical enterprise together. William procures materials in Elwynn Forest while Morgan operates their shop in Stormwind.

faq.q: Why doesn't William deliver the package himself?
aliases: why doesn't william go to stormwind
faq.answer: William is tied up managing his trade and collecting alchemical ingredients out in Goldshire. He prefers hiring passing adventurers who are already traveling north toward the capital gates.

faq.q: Do kobold candles have an actual alchemical use?
faq.answer: Yes. Kobolds craft heavy tallow candles to navigate subterranean tunnels. Alchemists like the Pestle brothers repurpose this tallow and wax for sealing vials, creating unguents, and refining bases for various mixtures.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the shipment?
aliases: what next after shipment to stormwind
follow up quest shipment to stormwind
faq.answer: This delivery concludes the short chain that began with gathering kobold candles in Elwynn Forest. Morgan simply pays you for the courier work and welcomes your business in his shop.

angles.text: The Pestle family business is deeply tied to Elwynn's local reagents, and making a stop at their Stormwind shop is a familiar routine for gatherers and potion-makers alike.
Carrying supplies along the king's road into Stormwind is a classic rite of passage for young Alliance champions moving from countryside skirmishes into the bustling capital.
